name: United Methodist Church
source_policy: Official UMC sources only (umc.org): the Book of Discipline 2020/2024 (Confession of Faith, ¶120ff), the Social Principles as revised by the 2024 General Conference, the UMC Constitution summary, and Ask The UMC position pages.

evidence.quote: We believe the Holy Bible, Old and New Testaments, reveals the Word of God so far as it is necessary for our salvation.
We believe in Jesus Christ, truly God and truly man, in whom the divine and human natures are perfectly and inseparably united.
We believe we are never accounted righteous before God through our works or merit, but that penitent sinners are justified or accounted righteous before God only by faith in our Lord Jesus Christ.

Although women were ordained in the Methodist tradition as early as the late 1800s, it was the May 4, 1956 General Conference vote for full clergy rights that forever changed the face of ordained clergy.
The United Methodist Church continues to declare its belief in the full equality of women and the importance of women in decision-making and leadership positions at all levels of the church.

Within the church, we affirm marriage as a sacred, lifelong covenant that brings two people of faith, an adult man and woman of consenting age, or two adult persons of consenting age into union with one another
the 2024 General Conference removed all of those restrictions and replaced them with a series of affirmations and agreements about how all persons will be
The mission of the church is to make disciples of Jesus Christ for the transformation of the world.
The Constitution is universally-binding to all United Methodist conferences (annual, jurisdiction and central) and entities worldwide.
Integrally holding connectional unity and local freedom, we seek to proclaim and embody the gospel in ways responsible to our specific cultural and social context

nuance.title: The 2024 General Conference changes
paragraphs: The UMC is connectional: the Constitution and the Book of Discipline bind every conference, and General Conference sets church law for all of them. Governance is graded BINDING.

In 2024 the General Conference removed the restrictions on non-heterosexual clergy and revised the Social Principles. Marriage is now defined as a covenant between a man and a woman or between two adult persons, effective in full from January 1, 2025.
The UMC has ordained women with full clergy rights since 1956. A church's own evidence decides its own rating.
